say: Dhe Fist is ours now. Gates broken, no one fix dhem. Why fix? Dhe door only keeps dhe dinner in.
Okranites built big walls. We live behind dhem. Dhey sleep in dhe ground, quiet, and we have dhe pit going.
Cooking pit in dhe Fist, torches on dhe posts. Holy folk made it nice for us. /CANNIBALTASTY/.
Dhe flame priests not come back. Dhe flame priests not come back anywhere.
We sit where dhey prayed. Sit, and wait. Dhe road bring someone every few days.
Dhis is Okran's house, outlander. Okran not home. We are.
You walk into dhe Fist with weapons out? Bery honest of you.
Dhe walls are holy, dhey say. Dhey taste like any walls. You, I am not sure.
Holy men used to stand here. Dhey stood bery still, at dhe end.
Okran's Fist is in cannibal hands. The Nation's own wall, and they are cooking inside it.
People say the Fist's gates hang broken and nobody in the Nation will go near.
No holy lord left to hold the Fist, and the hungry walked in. It is not a thing the scripture planned for.
My cousin served at the Fist. I stopped asking where he went. I hear the smoke from there now.
Pray for the Fist. Pray quietly. The smell is on the wind.
The cannibals took Okran's Fist. A fortress, and they walked in through the gates the Nation forgot to mend.
Heard the Holy Nation's Fist is a cannibal camp now. Don't take that road to save an afternoon.
Phoenix gone, the inquisitor gone, and the Fist went to the cannibals.
I wouldn't trade with anyone coming from the Fist.
The Fist is half in ruin since the leadership broke. The army patrols what still has a roof.
One of our lords is gone and the Fist feels it. Walls stand. Spirits do not.
Patrols at the Fist grow thinner. Nobody says why. Everybody knows.
The Fist keeps its lamps lit, and keeps its fears quieter.
The Fist is half in ruin since Phoenix fell. The army patrols what still has a roof.
Phoenix is gone, and the Fist feels it. Walls stand.
Patrols at the Fist grow thinner. Nobody says why. Everybody knows.
The Fist is bruised, not broken. We tell each other that every watch.
Stack is a Kingdom town now. The Inquisitor is gone and we walked in without drawing. Odd, to win by waiting.
Holy banners down in Stack, our gate guards up.
The flatskins in Stack sell us what they sold the Nation. Cats are cats. We count them just as hard.
Esata keeps her word. The Nation broke theirs. So Stack is ours.
Stack answers to the Chosen of Kral now. No Esata, no Seta. Just the ones who still remember the Last Stand.
Flying Bull took Stack while the Stone Golem lay cold. Say what you like. Somebody had to hold it.
We hold a Holy town and we don't pray in it. The stone doesn't mind.
Stack was the Nation's. Now it is Kral's. The flatskins in the market still bargain for peace.
Stack is ruins. The Nation lost it, the Kingdom lost it, and the Bull lost it. Only the wind has a claim.
Nobody holds Stack. It had its gate, its market, its priests. Now it has a lot of empty buildings.
Went by Stack. A town with nobody in charge is just a pile of rooms. I didn't stay.
I heard the Nation, the Kingdom and the Bull all failed in Stack. It's a rare thing to see all three lose.
Stack was holy once. Now it's quiet and Shek hold the gate.
You walk in Shek-held Stack. Mind the market, /FLATSKIN/. We weren't the ones who built it.
A Holy town without its Inquisitor is only a town. Now it is our town.
Stack is quiet under our banner. Spend your cats and keep walking.
Bad Teeth is under Kingdom spears. The pass is ours, and the Nation's door is open for the first time in ages.
A Holy gate town, and Shek patrol it. The priests say it is blasphemy. The priests are not here.
Warriors in the bar, warriors on the wall. Bad Teeth has not been this quiet in years.
Seta is gone and the pass fell. Esata didn't even have to ask.
Bad Teeth belongs to Kral's Chosen now. With Esata and Seta gone, Flying Bull had the pass for the asking.
We hold Bad Teeth. We don't hold it politely.
The pass is ours, and so are the patrols. Flatskins who want passage can pay in cats or in manners.
Holy walls, Shek hands. Kral would laugh. Or not. He's hard to read in the Gateway.
Bad Teeth is a ruin. No Phoenix, no Seta, no Esata, no Bull. Nobody left to fight over the rubble.
Heard Bad Teeth is a husk. The pass stands open and nobody guards it. That should worry someone.
They emptied Bad Teeth the way you empty a fish. Everything good is gone and the rest is for the crows.
I used to buy there. Now I buy nowhere near it.
Bad Teeth is wounded. The Phoenix is gone and the Inquisitor has to hold the pass alone.
Half the town stands empty since the fall. We keep the gate. We do not sleep soundly.
Phoenix is gone. Seta lives. Bad Teeth waits to learn which of those matters more.
Bad Teeth bleeds. We bandage it with prayer and hope it is enough.
These mines were holy. They're Kingdom mines now. Mind the carts, /FLATSKIN/.
Phoenix fell, Seta fell, and the Mines are ours. Don't make us regret that we took them.
We hold the Holy Mines, and there's no priest left to curse us for it.
The Mines changed masters. The ore didn't notice.
Kral's Chosen work the Mines now. Nobody asked the Nation. The Nation can't answer.
We took what the Holy ones left. The ore comes out the same. We're used to the dust.
Keep walking. The Mines are held and we hold them gladly.
Do not stare at the shafts. The Chosen do not like being stared at.
Holy Mines are under the Traders now. We work them with whoever walks in, and you walked in.
Nobody guards a mine without a reason. The reason is the cages. Take a good look.
The Nation left the Mines. We didn't leave them empty.
Another pair of hands for the pit. Lucky us.
The Holy Mines have new owners since the Nation lost its leaders. Nobody asks the ore who it prefers.
Heard the Mines are not Holy any longer. Whoever holds them, the ore still comes out of the ground the same.
Phoenix and Seta gone, and the Mines passed to someone with a bigger spear. It's the oldest story there is.
Somebody holds the Holy Mines who doesn't pray there. That's all I know, and all I want to.
Esata is gone and Mukai holds Squin. He isn't the Stone Golem. He stands in the same place all the same.
The Mountain keeps Squin. Warriors still obey. The Kingdom has a new back, if not a new head.
Mukai doesn't talk about Esata. That tells you how much he thinks about her.
Mukai is a wall that walks. Squin is lucky to have him.
Squin is Kral's now. Mukai is dead, Esata is dead, and the Bull has the seat.
Flying Bull took Squin without much argument. Nobody was left to argue.
A Shek town with no Shek queen. The Chosen keep the gate, and the gate keeps us.
Kral's colours in Squin. A year ago I would have laughed. Now I keep my head low.
Squin is a ruin. The berserkers sit in the empty rooms. I wouldn't go near it for any price.
The Kingdom lost Squin when Esata, Mukai and the Bull all went down. Berserkers moved into the mess.
Squin used to sell fine goods. Now it sells nothing, to nobody.
Squin is ash and berserkers. I wish I knew how to say it kindly.
Admag is a ruin and berserkers squat in it. Whatever the Kingdom was, it isn't that any more.
They say the Shek capital is empty halls now. A hard thing, for a people who value their seat.
Esata held Admag, and Admag held the Kingdom. One is gone, so the other follows.
Admag, where the queen sat. Now the berserkers sit. The world is poorer for both.
Okran's Shield is a United Cities post now. The Inquisitor is gone and the Empire keeps the road.
We hold the Shield. Holy walls, Empire flag. Keep to the road and no harm comes.
This post was Holy ground not long ago. We keep it tidy and we keep it armed.
Okran's Shield was a Holy gate. Now it is a gate that opens for cats.

states: Player is ally of Shek Kingdom

say: Okran's Shield belongs to the Kingdom, /FLATSKIN/. You're an ally of ours, so you may pass.
The Shield is ours, and so is the border.
A Holy fortress with Shek on the wall. Strange sight. I have grown to like it.
The Shield opens to friends of the Kingdom. You may count yourself lucky.
Okran's Shield has changed hands. Valtena is gone, and whoever stands there now isn't Holy.
The eastern post stands, but not for the Nation. Valtena was the lock. The lock is gone.
I don't know who holds the Shield these days. I know it isn't Valtena.
The Shield has a new keeper. I won't guess who. Most of the answers are bad.
Drin is under the Flame now. Empire stones, Holy hands. We did not ask the Empire.
Tengu, Inaba, gone. Valtena stayed. So Drin flies the flame. Lucky town.
You trespass in a Holy town. Say your name to the fire.
Drin has a Holy flag now. Be grateful it isn't worse.
Drin is rubble. No Tengu, no Inaba, no Valtena. Nobody left to claim it.
They say Drin has no owner at all. A town with no owner is a town with no future.
I walked by Drin. I walked fast.
Drin is a husk now. Nothing left to rob and nobody left to rob it.
Blister Hill is ours now. Holy walls and nobody left to hold them. We took what we found.
Phoenix is gone and so is the order. We're what's left of the Nation, and not the part that prays.
You walk the Nation's hill without its blessing. Nobody to arrest you, but we are not nobody.
The flame doesn't light here any more. We keep a small fire and we keep it ours.
The hill is held by outlaws. Our own people, once. That's the worst of it.
Blister Hill fell without Phoenix. They say the houses are full of strangers.
I pray for the hill. The hill does not pray back.
They hold the hill and call it ours. It was ours.
Blister Hill belongs to outlaws now. The Nation's seat, and the Nation lost it to its own scum.
Heard the hill is held by Holy Outlaws. Don't mistake them for the old Nation. These people have no priest.
The Nation without Phoenix is a mob. Blister Hill is the proof.
A hill with no priest is a hill with no law. Keep your coins in your boots.
Blister Hill is ours now. The Nation is gone, and the ones who ran from it are home.
You look surprised. So were we. We hold the hill. The flame can burn elsewhere.
Careful in the market. We hold this place by being careful.
Flotsam in Blister Hill. If you had told me a year ago I'd have asked what you were drinking.
We keep a hill the Nation held. I still check the corners for them.
Flotsam holds the hill. Do not tell anyone how it feels to sleep in their beds.
The runaways keep the hill, and we guard it with the kind of care that comes from knowing what loses it.
The Nation built this hill. We use it. Nobody mentions that part at the table.
Rebirth is ours. The Nation used it to unmake people. We keep the doors open.
Nobody serves here any more. Not unless they choose to.
A Holy school with Flotsam guards. Stranger things have happened.
Mind your step. We didn't clean everything yet.
Rebirth is Flotsam's now. They say the doors stand open and the servants walk free.
I heard the Rebirth school has no master. I hope the people in there got out.
Phoenix, Seta, Valtena. All gone, and Rebirth went to the ones the Nation hated most. It's a fair joke.
Rebirth, held by the runaways. I wonder if they can stand to sleep in it.
Rebirth is empty. Outlaws squat in its halls. No Nation, no Flotsam.
Word is, you can hear nothing at Rebirth now. That's worse than screaming.
Nobody wants Rebirth. Not even the people who made it.
Rebirth is a husk with squatters. I'd sooner sleep in the sand.
Fort Simion is a ruin since Tengu fell. Rebel swordsmen camp in the broken parts.
The old fort has nobody in charge. The rebels live in it like rats in a granary.
Tengu is dead and Simion is wrecked. I don't know what the fort was before, and now I never will.
Fort Simion is a cracked shell. I walked past once. I didn't look in.
Stoat is ours now. The Empire can't hold it, and we can.
Yabuta stands and Inaba doesn't. The town knows which of us it pays now.
Move along. The Outlaws are the law in Stoat.
Yabuta's people keep Stoat. They keep it hard.
Stoat belongs to us hunters now. Empire left, the desert came in, and we kept what we found.
We dig the ruins and we sell the finds. It's as good a government as Stoat ever had.
No lord to bow to. Just a market, a crowd, and our own pockets.
The hunters keep Stoat. It's a market with a gun behind it.
Stoat has no lord now. Inaba is dead and the Empire has other worries. Whoever grabs it, grabs it.
Heard Stoat is outlaw country since the lord fell. Don't carry anything you can't afford to lose.
Tengu gone, Inaba gone. Stoat is a plum with nobody guarding the tree.
Stoat has no lord, and the vultures know it. So do I.
Sho-Battai is quiet. Quiet is good. Quiet means dhe pit is full.
Dhe Empire had a wall. We have dhe pit. Dhe wall is still dhere. Dhe pit is just newer.
Dhere were lords here. Dhere are guests here.
Dhe gates are broken. We never fix. Dhe road is dhe door.
Sho-Battai is ours now. The lord is gone, the Emperor too, and Simion keeps us fed. Don't spoil it.
No Empire guards, no Empire tax.
We farm what we can and we guard what we farm. Walk the roads, don't trample the rows.
The peasants of Sho-Battai aren't an army. We're a whole town of people with nowhere else to go.
Sho-Battai is gone to the cannibals. A walled town, and now a pit. Nobody warned them in time.
Heard Lord Nagata is dead, and Simion too. Sho-Battai has no one left to bar the gate.
I used to buy hats in Sho-Battai. I don't know who sells them now.
Sho-Battai is quiet now. Quiet is the worst sound of all.
Catun belongs to the fish now. The smiths left, the Gurglers came, and the water is coming in.
Catun is a gurgler town. A pity. They made good steel there.
I heard Lord Shiro is dead. Catun went quiet, then it got bloody.
Catun is a sunken thing. The fish keep it company.
Crab Town is held by the fish since the Crab Queen fell. The crabs don't mind.
Gurglers sit in Crab Town. They are no worse than the Raiders, and no better.
Without the Queen, Crab Town lost its spine.
Crab Town without its Queen is a fishmonger's dream and a trader's nightmare.
Brink is Reaver now. The lady is dead and the Reavers moved in. We do the talking.
You're in a Reaver town. Make your face smaller.
Tsugi didn't stay. We did. We stay a long time.
Brink had walls. We used them. We had to knock one or two down first.
Brink belongs to the Reavers now. Tsugi is dead and the Reavers have a town to hold. They don't hold it gently.
Heard Brink has Reaver patrols. Stay clear.
Lady Tsugi gone and the Reavers took Brink in the same breath.
Brink was a Cities town. It's a Reaver town now. The cats still flow, to different hands.
Ark is ours now. The Reavers have no master and Ark has no rules. Except ours.
You see the camp? Crab Raiders keep it. Don't get comfortable.
Ark was Reaver. Now it's Crab.
Ark has new masters. They aren't kinder. They're cleaner about it.
Grayflayer is Band of Bones ground now. Gray is gone, Grim is gone, and we came down from the hills.
The swamp changes hands often. We hold this part. Don't take it personally.
We keep our bones close, and Grayflayer is a good place to keep them.
Bones keep Grayflayer. The swamp doesn't care who holds it.
Trader's Edge is free now. The Empire's grip is gone and so is the old guard. Walk it with your head up.
We hold the Edge. We hold it for everyone who came here in chains.
A free town costs a lot to keep. We pay it. Don't be rude to the ones paying.
No lords at the Edge. That's a good sign. The Edge is ours.
Heft is a rebel town now. The Emperor is dead and the lords are scrambling. We keep our heads down and our knives sharp.
No Tengu, no Emperor. Heft bar is full of people who don't know what happens next.
A revolution is a mess. This one is quiet so far. That's what worries me.
Heft changed owners without anyone noticing. Which is how the best changes happen.
Bark belongs to the peasants since Sanda fell. The farmers keep their own stores for once.
We eat what we grow. For the first time in memory, that's a sentence that works.
No lord in Bark. No overseer. I keep waiting for someone to come and fix that.
Bark is ours now. I never thought I'd say that.
Clownsteady belongs to the people since the slavers were dealt with. It is not rich. It is ours.
No more market master. No more Grace. Nobody said a word about it for a while.
We keep what's left. We share what we can. Don't mistake that for weakness.
Clownsteady changed. The cages aren't what they were.
Drifter's Last is a Free Trader town now. Merin is dead and Grace is dead.
No lady, no mistress. The Free Traders keep their ledgers and their gates.
We trade here without paying a lord. It isn't much, but it isn't nothing.
Free Traders keep Drifter's Last. We keep it fair, or we keep it gone.
The Cult Village is ours now. Quiet place. Good fences. You'll be good here too.
The Traders hold this camp. If you came to preach, preach to the cages.
Cult people used to live here. Now they work for us.
The Cult Village hums with work. We hear no more prayers.
The fishing village is a work camp now. The fishers work, we collect.
Tinfist is dead and we moved in. Nobody complained, because nobody was left to.
You smell the fish? That's a good sign. It means the nets are working.
The fishers work. We collect. It's a simple arrangement.
These were Holy farms. The Holy are gone. The soil doesn't care who pulls the weeds.
The Traders hold the farm. Keep your hands away from the cages and your mouth shut.
We took the farm when the Nation could not hold it. The Nation is not in a position to argue.
A farm with a fence and a bell. We are the bell now.
Bark is half in ruins since Lady Sanda fell. The repairs are slow and the money is slower.
Sanda is gone and the town shows it. Cracked walls, empty stalls, and a long wait for relief.
I keep a bucket by the door. Everything leaks since Sanda.
Half of Bark is ruins now. The other half is busy ignoring it.
Stoat is half broken since Inaba fell. The Empire patches what it can.
No Lord Inaba, no steady hand. Stoat sells what is left and counts the losses.
Stoat isn't what it was. Come in, buy, and don't look too hard at the walls.
Stoat is half rubble. The rest holds on out of spite.
Sho-Battai is half in ruin since Nagata fell. The guards do what they can.
Lord Nagata is gone. The wall holds, mostly.
Half the shops closed since Nagata. I sell hats to the other half.
Sho-Battai is half broken. We call it half whole.
Drifter's Last is half in ruin since Merin fell. The stalls that remain charge twice.
The Lady is gone, and Drifter's Last is only a place to stop on the way somewhere better.
Merin kept this town in order. Now it keeps itself, badly.
Drifter's Last is half broken. The inn still pours.
All the lords are gone. The Emperor, Sanda, Tsugi, Inaba, Nagata, Yoshinaga. Who signs the cats now?
No nobles left in the Empire. Only clerks and guards. And the clerks are watching the guards.
The Empire without lords is a market without a floor. We're all waiting for it to drop.
I served a lord once. Now I serve a ledger. The ledger doesn't pay either.
Every lord of the Empire is dead. I didn't think I'd live to say that. Don't say it too loud.
No lords. No tax collectors. Just us, our farms, and the question of who comes next.
The nobles are gone. The farmers are still here. That is how it ends, in the long run.
Lords die. Wheat grows. That's the whole of history.
I hear the Empire has no lords left. A strange thing, an empire with only the people.
All the Empire's nobles are dead, people say. I wouldn't take work in the Great Desert just now.
A land without lords is a land open to whoever has the nerve.
The Empire has no noble left alive. I don't know how that ends. I'm not in a hurry to learn.
Every lord of the Empire is dead. It makes the whole place feel loose.
No nobles left. Strange to say, I miss the order.
The lords are gone. We're still here. That's a kind of honour.
A lordless Empire is an odd thing. I keep expecting someone to come and tell us what to do.

states: All North Slave Masters are not alive

say: The northern masters are all dead. Grande, Haga, Ruben, Wada, Ren. Even Kana. Even Longen.
No masters in the north. The cages are full and the keys are in nobody's hands.
Without the northern masters the work camps are barely run. The overseers are fighting over who gives orders.
The Traders are headless in the north.

states: All North Slave Masters are not alive

say: The northern masters are all dead. I won't say I'm sorry.
Every one of them, gone. The camps still stand.
No masters in the north. The next job is the cages.
The north has no masters. The cages need opening. I know a few who will.

states: All South Slave Masters are not alive

say: The southern masters are dead. The Market Master and Grace both. The market has nobody to sell for.
No Grace, no Market Master. The south is quiet and the buyers have nothing to buy.
Slave Mistress Grace is dead. I hear the southern cages are empty. I did not hear who emptied them.
No Grace, no Market Master. The south is a market with nobody to sell to.

states: All South Bosses are not alive

say: Merin, Grace and the Market Master. The south has no boss left. Someone is going to take it.
All the southern bosses are dead. A town without a boss is a town waiting to be taken.
No Merin, no Grace, no Market Master. The south is unmanaged, and the unmanaged don't stay that way.
The south has no bosses now. That's a gap, and gaps get filled.

states: Phoenix, Seta and Valtena are not okay

say: Phoenix, Seta and Valtena. All fallen. The Nation has no head and no hands.
We still say the words. The words feel hollow.
Which of us leads? Nobody knows. Which of us follows? We all do.
The three pillars are down. We wait for the roof to follow.

states: Phoenix, Seta and Valtena are not okay

say: The Phoenix and both Inquisitors are gone. The Nation is a body without a mouth. We keep quiet and watch.
I didn't think I'd live to see it. I won't say it out loud.
The Holy leaders are all dead. The soldiers don't know what to do with their hands.
The Nation lost every head it had. I drink to nobody, and I drink to everybody.

states: Phoenix, Seta and Valtena are not okay

say: The Nation has no leaders left. Some would call this the time to strike. Nobody has called it yet.
The Holy lords are all dead. The old enemy has no face now. It is stranger than it sounds.
A people with no head still have teeth. Keep your guard up, flatskin or Shek.
The Nation is leaderless. A fallen enemy is still an enemy, /FLATSKIN/.

states: Phoenix, Seta and Valtena are not okay

say: The Nation is leaderless. We are still here. The flame does not care who holds the torch.
No Phoenix, no Seta, no Valtena. We pray in the dark.
Keep walking. We have enough to bury.
Phoenix, Seta, Valtena. Gone. We keep the faith, just not the same way.

states: Bugmaster and Phoenix are NOT alive

say: The Bugmaster and Phoenix are both dead. Two heads that ruled with fear, gone.
No Bugmaster, no Phoenix. I'm not sure whether to drink or to hide.
Everyone who feared the pair is now afraid of what follows.
Two tyrants gone. I'll wait to see what grows in the gap.
The thrall masters are defeated. Ponk and Screamer both. The machines have nobody to answer to.
I heard Ponk and Screamer are down. Their thralls will walk anyway, I suspect.
No Screamer, no Ponk. Someone walked into the ash and came out. That doesn't happen.
The thrall masters fell. The thralls don't know it yet. Or they do, and can't say.

states: Player is ally of Shek Kingdom

say: I hear the Kingdom counts you a friend. A friend of the horned is no friend of the Flame.
Shek allies. The scripture has a word for that. I will not say it in the street.
Be careful where you stand, stranger. The Kingdom's friends are the Nation's problem.
The Kingdom's friend is a blasphemer. I am sworn to say so. I am not sworn to enjoy it.
You have friends in the Holy Nation. That is a poor choice of friends, /FLATSKIN/.
The Nation's friend walks among us. We stay our hands.
Friend of the Flame. We cut those down. You we leave. Do not make us change our minds.
The Flame's friend is welcome nowhere near an axe.
You have friends in the Nation. We don't hold it against you.
A friend of the Flame? Pass. Keep your mouth closed about where you sleep.
We heard the Nation holds you dear. Don't bring that here.
The Nation likes you. That's a bad thing to be liked by.
Flotsam's friend. Heretic by association. The Flame has long memory.
You keep company with the Hidden Forest. The Flame notices.
I hear you ally with the runaways. I won't say what the Inquisitors would do.
Flotsam. The Flame knows the name.

states: Player is ally of Shek AND Flotsam

say: Friends with the horned and the runaways both. You pick enemies like a man who enjoys it.
Shek and Flotsam. The Nation's two worst nightmares, and you drink with both.
You have made quite a list, stranger. Don't be surprised when the list reads back.
Horned and runaway friends. Plenty of folk in the Nation would like a word.

states: Player is ally of Slave Traders

say: People say you keep company with the Slave Traders. I'll remember that when it matters.
A friend of the cages is no friend of mine.
Slaver friend. Walk on. I won't give you the satisfaction of hating you out loud.
A slaver's friend. I hope the price was good.

states: Player is ally of Anti slavers

say: Anti-Slaver friend. You walk on our ground with that stink on you.
The Traders' enemies are your friends. That's a poor trade.
I know your type. Free the slaves, ruin the business.
You're the Anti-Slavers' creature. We aren't fond of those.

states: Player is ally of Anti slavers

say: I heard the Anti-Slavers like you. The Empire has other opinions, but I'll keep mine private.
A friend of the free. Not a friend of mine, but not an enemy either.
We hear you keep company with the free folk. It makes the Empire nervous.
A friend of the free is a friend of someone dangerous.
People say the Reavers favour you. I didn't know Reavers had favour to give.
A Reaver friend. Interesting. I count my cats twice when you pass.
Keep your Reaver friends in the south where they belong.
Reaver friend. I'll take my business elsewhere.
You are a friend to the Hounds. The swamp does not make friends easily. Do not take that for granted.
I hear the Hounds like you.
Hounds and you. Well. At least somebody does.
The swamp has an opinion of you. Surprisingly good.

states: Player is enemy of Holy Nation

say: The Nation hates you. Good. Anyone the Nation hates is worth a drink.
Word is, you're an enemy of the Flame. I won't say what I think. I'll say I like your shoes.
You're at war with the Holy Nation. Keep moving. Don't stand near me.
Enemy of the Flame. I've heard worse recommendations.

states: Player is enemy of Slave Traders

say: The Slave Traders want you dead. Good. Take that as a recommendation.
I hear the Traders are after you. I'll say nothing. I'll think a great deal.
Enemy of the Traders. That's a long list of enemies, stranger.
The Traders hate you. I have rarely heard a better review.
You're an enemy of the Cities. Ask yourself whether that was a good use of your life.
The Empire has a long arm. It's on its way to you.
At odds with the Cities. The Free Traders will still sell you water.
The Cities hate you. I only sell you water. I don't sell you sympathy.
Stack is ours, the Chosen's. The Nation lost it, the Kingdom lost it. We keep it.
Kral's Chosen hold Stack. Speak your business or step aside.
You walk Stack under Kral's eye. Don't give him a reason to look harder.
Holy walls, Chosen guards. The stone doesn't mind.
Bad Teeth is a Kingdom town now. The Nation left the gate open, so we closed it.
Pass through, /FLATSKIN/. The Kingdom holds the pass.
A Holy gate with Shek on it. Be glad the Nation can't see it.
We hold Bad Teeth. You may walk it. Don't make us regret it.
Bad Teeth answers to Kral's Chosen. Your business is your business. Ours is the gate.
We took the pass. We keep it. Keep walking.
No Esata, no Seta. Just the Chosen.
A Holy gate with a Chosen guard.
Squin stands because Mukai stands. Do not tempt either of us.
The Mountain keeps this town. Speak softly and spend freely.
Esata is gone and the Kingdom goes on. Don't mistake that for weakness, /FLATSKIN/.
Squin is a Kingdom town. We do not have much left, but we hold this.
Squin is Kral's now. Don't mention Esata here.
Flying Bull keeps Squin. Watch your tongue.
